description: This file contains functions and types for configuring, authenticating, and managing Ollama models within the openclaw plugin SDK, including model pulling, authentication checks, and user prompts.

classes.name: OllamaCloudAuthResult
classes.description: Result of Ollama cloud authentication check, indicating sign-in status and optional sign-in URL.

classes.name: OllamaPullChunk
classes.description: Represents a chunk of data during Ollama model pull, including status, total, completed, and error message.

classes.name: OllamaPullResult
classes.description: Result of attempting to pull an Ollama model, indicating success or failure with a message.

methods.name: normalizeOllamaModelName
methods.description: Normalizes model name strings, removing 'ollama/' prefix and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isOllamaCloudModel
methods.description: Checks if a model name indicates a cloud model based on suffix ':cloud'.

methods.name: formatOllamaPullStatus
methods.description: Formats the status string during model pull for display purposes.

methods.name: checkOllamaCloudAuth
methods.description: Checks if the user is authenticated with Ollama cloud at the given base URL.

methods.name: pullOllamaModelCore
methods.description: Core function to download an Ollama model, streaming progress and handling errors.

methods.name: pullOllamaModel
methods.description: Downloads an Ollama model with a user prompt and progress indicator.

methods.name: pullOllamaModelNonInteractive
methods.description: Downloads an Ollama model without user interaction, suitable for scripts.

methods.name: buildOllamaModelsConfig
methods.description: Builds configuration objects for a list of model names.

methods.name: applyOllamaProviderConfig
methods.description: Applies Ollama provider settings to the main configuration object.

methods.name: buildOllamaProvider
methods.description: Creates an Ollama provider configuration, fetching models and enriching context.

methods.name: promptAndConfigureOllama
methods.description: Interactively prompts user for Ollama setup options and configures accordingly.

methods.name: configureOllamaNonInteractive
methods.description: Configures Ollama setup without user interaction, for automation.

methods.name: ensureOllamaModelPulled
methods.description: Ensures a specific Ollama model is downloaded and available.
